en-US.longDescription: GstPipelineStudio aims to provide a graphical user interface to the GStreamer framework. From a first step in the framework with a simple pipeline to a complex pipeline debugging, the tool provides a friendly interface to add elements to a pipeline and debug it.
en-US.name: GstPipelineStudio
